meta.title: Georgia Institute of Technology Outside Counsel Guidelines (Feb 2023)
meta.licence: No licence stated. Government/public-institution publication posted on the open web; used only as a public document for internal evaluation, not redistributed.
meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. Hits: email 1, case_party_marker 3. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

pii_scan.disposition: Business and agency contact details only; no private-person data expected. Safe for local evaluation use.

rules.paraphrase: Billing above the approved rate for a timekeeper or level is reduced to the approved rate; increases need prior written approval.
Additions or substitutions of billers need approval; temporary attorneys and summer associates are not paid unless approved.
No payment for more than ten hours by one timekeeper in a day without advance approval.
Only one attorney attends a trial, hearing, meeting or deposition, and internal conferences and internal email are not paid.
Ramp-up, training, clerical, administrative, invoice-preparation and basic research time is overhead and not paid.
Monthly invoices within thirty days of period end; no payment for services over 90 days before submission.

params.rounding: exact or rounded up or down

rules.paraphrase: Hours must be the exact time or rounded to the nearest tenth; block billing is not paid.
Block-billed time is not paid and vague descriptions are unacceptable.
Invoices identify the matter, date, activity, subject and persons, one matter per invoice, with travel time in its own entry.

params.working_travel: full rate only if only Institute matters worked

rules.paraphrase: Travel time is generally not compensated; productive working time is paid at the full rate if only Institute work is done.

params.air_and_rail: standard coach, approved in writing in advance

rules.paraphrase: Coach fares only with advance approval, state travel rates for mileage, meals and lodging, no alcohol or miscellaneous groupings.
Photocopying, postage, phone, fax and research databases are general overhead and not reimbursed.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: A strategic plan and budget are required for matters above 30,000 dollars.
Non-SAAG invoices follow the billing procedures appendix.
